summary: DataMeds AI filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 stock purchase agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Helomics Corporation from Axe Compute Inc. Consideration comprised 636,328 DataMeds shares, about 19.99% of pre-deal shares outstanding, plus a 7% convertible note with $1,363,672 principal maturing September 11, 2029, convertible at $1.00 per share pending stockholder approval. Closing occurred simultaneously; Helomics is now wholly owned. No advisor or board recommendation named. Watch the stockholder meeting within 75 days and ratchet-driven dilution risk.
